notes.title: PowerWash Simulator 2 announced for release in 2025 with split-screen co-op
notes.notes: Ah hell, here we go again, I'm going to be hooked on it. FuturLab have revealed PowerWash Simulator 2 is coming and it will be this year too.Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2025/03/powerwash-simulator-2-announced-for-release-in-2025-with-split-screen-co-op/
